title: Penalty Relief on Employer UI Tax Accounts: The Amount Requested
content:
**Amount requested.** On the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, the relief requested is the penalty paid for the relieved quarter, in full, rounded to the cent. The relieved quarter is the quarter of the most recent payment applied to a penalty on the account, and the penalty paid is every payment amount applied to penalty for that quarter, added together.

| Element | Source |
|---|---|
| Relieved quarter | The quarter of the payment, applied to penalty, with the latest entry date in the account's balance history |
| Penalty paid | All payment amounts applied to penalty for that quarter |
| Rounding | To the cent, once, on the amount requested |

## Worked figures (hypothetical account)

The balance history shows these payments applied to penalty:

| Entry date | Quarter | Applied to penalty |
|---|---|---|
| 14 February 2026 | 2025-Q2 | USD 50.00 |
| 9 June 2026 | 2025-Q4 | USD 100.00 |
| 21 July 2026 | 2025-Q4 | USD 80.00 |

1. The most recent payment applied to a penalty is the one of 21 July 2026, so the relieved quarter is 2025-Q4.
2. The penalty paid for 2025-Q4 is 100.00 and 80.00 added together: USD 180.00.
3. The relief requested is **USD 180.00**. The payment for 2025-Q2 plays no part.

**Point of judgement.** A penalty booked for a quarter but not yet paid adds nothing to the penalty paid; only amounts actually applied to penalty count.
